Title: Extended support for .NET 7 (STS) ends on 14 May 2024

Body.Content:
On 14 May 2024, extended support for .NET 7 (STS) will end. Your apps that are hosted on App Service will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available and we’ll no longer provide customer service for .NET 7 (STS). Learn more about App Service language support.

Required action

To avoid potential security vulnerabilities and minimize risk for your App Service apps, follow the steps to upgrade your app to .NET 8 (LTS) before 14 May 2024.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
